# Gender by Year

```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
athlete_events <- read_csv("Data/Raw/athlete_events.csv")

source("R/data_prep.r")
```

## Column
```{r}
#| title: "Frauenanteil bei Olympischen Spielen über Zeit"

library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(knitr)
library(markdown)

p <- ggplot(gender_by_year_female, aes(x = Year, y = share, color = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Summer" = "#E69F00", "Winter" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(
    x = "Jahr",
    y = "Anteil weiblicher Athlet:innen",
    color = "Saison"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggplotly(p)
```
